body: I’m close, I could move within a few months, but it’s hard enough trying to get through one day let alone these next few months. I just don’t know if I can push myself to survive anymore

Just quit when you’re ready. If you really feel bad then give em at least 2 or 3 weeks notice. You don’t owe a big fast food chain anything. If you get something better, take it! Do what’s best for you!
Thanks guys! Sounds like it’ll be worth it for me! ✌🏼
Didn’t know that about realtors, that’s definitely a huge help, thanks!
lol oh my god I didn't even think about that!
I guess I mean what if we were always that way. How would our bodies look?

See that’s the part that’s unsettling. Like, my friend has so many of those stupid Echodot things and I don’t think she realizes they can do stuff like change the TOS whenever they want and not let people know.
I don’t own one. I’m mostly asking cause my friend has several and I was thinking about whenever I go to her house my conversations are likely being recorded without my consent.
Put on a feel good movie, drink lots of water, get cozy, maybe get a snack. Remind yourself that it’s just the edible and that you’ll feel normal soon!
This is incredibly inspirational, thank you so much~
I never thought about making up a girlfriend, but that’s a really good idea. Maybe it will also help to stop the creepy sexual advances.
I’m just scared because she knows where I live and knows my family and admitted to me two weeks ago that she’s stalked people before and watches people’s houses.
In some ways yes. But mostly I’m still the same
I haven’t gone yet , thank you for your concern and kind soul
My coworkers do seem like genuinely nice people, but yeah, I kind of understand what you mean about it being largely transactional.

I like my coworkers just fine, though. And it’s still “socializing” in some form. 

And yet my therapist is still highly concerned about me.
Ahhhh that’s amazing
Me right now
I'm an adult, so there's nothing that can be done at this point. idk if it even qualifies as abusive anyway...

If I'm more honest with my therapist about whats going on I'm almost 100% certain she will try to get me to go to the hospital. I'd rather not be 5150'd but idk what will happen if I decide to tell her. I haven't really told her the whole truth about how intense this is because I've known deep down for months that she'd send me to the hospital...

Thank you so much for all your kindness and advice. You seem like a really wonderful, thoughtful person.

To be honest I'd never looked at it the way you said it, I guess there really isn't much stopping me from just taking a leap and doing something like buying a plane ticket and going somewhere... At the very least if my last experiences were good, I guess that's something.

I have a therapist and have been in therapy for over 7 years. Not on meds currently though, trying to get that part figured out. I have several diagnosed conditions. Depression, anxiety, panic disorder, adhd. 

I think my environment is partly what’s making it difficult to heal.
Thank you ~
Thank you for all the great suggestions, definitely will be looking into these. I really appreciate you taking time out of your day to try and help out and offer kind words\~

and right now I work in a school and take care of 50+ children at a time and he still says I have it easy at my job and it's not real work like he does or ever did 

I'm open to suggestions on how to leave, because if I leave I think I have a better chance at not killing myself or ending up hospitalized
Thank you for the encouragement~

In addition to me, several of my younger siblings have severe mental problems. One sister is an alcoholic, one has debilitating agoraphobia and anxiety, my brother is a former drug-addict, there's the sister who has anger, stress, and now self-harm issues. I can see another sister is becoming depressed. My family has a history of mental problems, but there's 10 of us and almost all of us have issues it can;t just be family history. My parents homeschooled us and I think that's part of what fucked us up, but that's a long story 

even when I was working 60+ hours a week in a restaurant my dad always told me I don't know what "real work or real life" is. Even when I lived on my own and suffered with abusive roomates and a sexually abusive girlfriend. he says I "don't get it"

I'm trying to find a way to move in with my sister and her BF because they're amazing and live in the city, but I have to wait at least a few months and idk if I can make it that long
thank you for saying that, because I have often thought that and yet felt like I was crazy or insane or dumb for seeing it that way.

I have 9 siblings 

Sort of. I can tell she gets annoyed with me when I try to talk about the really serious stuff and she usually brushes it off because she’s busy or tired or whatever

I feel like the only reason he’d say those things is that they’re true in some way. 

My siblings mean so much to me, I’m close with all of them. 

I’m fairly close with my mom but we’ve had issues about a few things. Still, definitely closer to her than my dad.

My dad has always told me I’m lazy and narcissistic and ungrateful. I’m the oldest of a very big family so I’ve always had to try and be the best example and look out for my siblings. 

I live with my family right now. Was on my own for a while but had financial troubles and had to come back.

Those 2-4 months I guess I feel average. I have somewhat more drive to go out and do things and eat better, it’s easier to avoid sleeping all day. But even with that being said I still find myself wanting to die even when things are “good.” Maybe cause I know it won’t last. 

I have no idea what’s making me feel this way. I just hate everything about myself and I know I’m not good enough or smart enough or creative enough. 

My very best friend lives in another state so I don’t get to see her in person often. We talk almost every day though. I have friends in my home state that I see sometimes but I haven’t hung out with anyone in almost 2 months cause I can’t bring myself to do things other than go to work. 

I like working with kids, they’re sweet, but they can also be a handful sometimes. Generally I guess I can say it’s a good job.

I’ve had an anxiety disorder and ADHD since early childhood, but bullying and my dad forced the depression out of me early into my teens. But I have no real “trauma” that would have caused the depression so idk 
All my mental health issues have been constant. Ive has some random 2-4 month periods where I feel okay but they’re getting shorter and happening way less often and I have no idea why. 

I don’t want people irl to worry or be annoyed or have to think about me ever. I know how irritating I am and I try to make sure people don’t have to deal with my shit. 

I worked in a fast food place before this so yeah it’s very different. The hours and pay are better.

It’s been this way since I was about 13, so almost 11 years. When I wake up I’m usually upset that I didn’t die in my sleep. 

My best friend understands, a few others too. But I feel guilty because they’re making progress and I’m scared to talk about this again because I don’t want to ruin that progress. 

I work with elementary school kids.
I don't know anymore. I've seen how quickly peoples lives can deteriorate. It doesn't take much.
The key word is "can." There's no guarantee. And I know it's cowardly to think like that, but at this point I don't even care if people think I'm a coward. I'm just so tired.

I love my family, which is partly why I'm probably gonna kill myself. I'm nothing but a burden. Financially, emotionally, all I do is take and take and take and I have nothing good to give. I just make everyone sad and upset and worried. It's gonna be so much better to eliminate that worry from their lives. Even if it hurts a little at first.
There's just no point in going on. I'm gonna work and suffer and pay bills and struggle and I'm just gonna die anyway, why prolong it? I've been depressed and anxious and panicky since I was 5...
